title: 第19章 醒脉丹你这丹药不对劲吧第20章 忽悠你接着忽悠
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
冷月涵眼睛微微眯起，眼神中透露出狐疑之色。
反倒是未曾和李玄有深入交流的上官柔儿被深深折服。
她瞪大双眸，眼里冒出崇拜的光芒。
双眸倒映出李玄那伟岸的身影，负手而立。
“区区些许剔除灵兽血脉杂质的丹药而已，顷刻炼化！”
上官柔儿瞪大乌黑的双眼，起身上前扯住李玄袖袍，激动的有些失态。
“多谢师弟愿意出手相助，这便是我偶然所得的丹方，还请师弟过目。”
李玄接过丹方的时候，一阵芳香扑鼻而来。
他倒是不曾有丝毫影响，只是有个退半步的动作，俯首紧盯丹方。
“醒脉丹，能够剔除灵兽体内的丹药，甚至比如今青云宗常用的同类丹药，药效强大三成。”
“果然是个极好的丹方，需要醒神草、帝流浆、陨星泪……”
李玄看着密密麻麻的炼丹材料，不由得感慨。
“丹方是好的，不过炼制的难度确实是比同类型丹药成倍递增，寻常丹修想来是没有把握的。”
话音刚落，上官柔儿弯腰歪头，用期待的眼神盯着李玄。
“师弟，你肯定是有把握的，对吗？”
同时一阵青色的灵光闪烁，却见得一只纯白三尾狐出现在上官柔儿的身旁。
通体毛发如初雪新裁，蓬松得似一团云絮。
三条绒尾如月下流泉般舒卷交叠，尾尖各缀着一缕淡金毫光。
最勾魂的是那双眼，琉璃般的赤瞳里浮动着碎银漩涡。
“嘤~~~”

狐儿忽地立起前肢，粉嫩肉垫轻搭李玄袖口，仿佛是在乞求。
甜妹+妲己的一套组合连招下来，李玄也是懵逼。
“怎么看个狐狸都眉清目秀的，怪不得纣王喜欢这个呢。”
恰好许久不曾言语的冷月涵再次暴击。
“莫非……你刚才是说大话的，其实根本炼制不出来？”
下一刻，李玄伸出两只手，推着冷月涵和上官柔儿离开房屋。
嘭！
随着木门被重重的关闭，李玄的声音也是响起。
“不要耽误我炼丹，接下来我要炼丹了，你们去其他地方稍作等候吧。”
上官柔儿回头露出感激的目光。
“师弟真是个大好人啊。”
三尾白狐也是亲昵的蹭着主人小腿，发出嘤嘤嘤的声音。
content_en:
Leng Yuehan's eyes narrowed slightly, with suspicion in his eyes.
On the contrary, Shangguan Rouer, who had never had in-depth communication with Li Xuan, was deeply impressed.
Her eyes widened with adoration.
His eyes reflected Li Xuan's majestic figure, standing with his hands behind his back.
"It's just a few pills to remove impurities from the bloodline of spirit beasts. It can be refined in an instant!"
Shangguan Rouer's dark eyes widened, she stood up and grabbed Li Xuan's sleeves, she was so excited that she lost her composure.
"Thank you, junior brother, for being willing to help. This is the elixir I got by chance. I would like to ask junior brother to take a look."
When Li Xuan took the prescription, a burst of fragrance hit his nostrils.
He didn't have any influence at all, he just took a half step back, lowered his head and stared at Dan Fang.
"The Awakening Pulse Pill can remove pills from the body of spirit beasts. It is even 30% more effective than the same pills commonly used in Qingyun Sect today."
"It is indeed an excellent pill recipe. It requires Awakening Herb, Emperor's Liquid, and Meteoric Tears..."
Li Xuan looked at the densely packed alchemy materials and couldn't help but sigh.
"The elixir recipe is good, but the difficulty of refining it is indeed exponentially higher than that of the same type of elixir. Ordinary elixir cultivators are not sure about it."
As soon as she finished speaking, Shangguan Rouer bent her head and stared at Li Xuan expectantly.
"Junior brother, you must be sure, right?"
At the same time, a green light flashed, and a pure white three-tailed fox appeared next to Shangguan Rouer.
The hair all over his body is as freshly cut as fresh snow, and as fluffy as a cloud.
The three velvet tails are curled and overlapped like springs flowing under the moon, and each tail tip is decorated with a ray of light gold.
The most fascinating thing is those eyes, with whirlpools of broken silver floating in the glass-like red pupils.
"嘤~~~"
Hu'er suddenly stood up with her forelimbs, her pink flesh pad lightly touching Li Xuan's sleeves, as if begging.
After the combo of Tianmei + Daji came down, Li Xuan was also stunned.
"No matter how beautiful a fox is, it's no wonder King Zhou likes this."
Leng Yuehan, who had not spoken for a long time, struck again.
"Could it be that... you were just talking big words, but you can't actually refine it at all?"
The next moment, Li Xuan stretched out his hands and pushed Leng Yuehan and Shangguan Rou'er out of the house.
Bang!
As the wooden door was slammed shut, Li Xuan's voice also sounded.
"Don't delay me refining the elixir. I'm going to make the elixir next. You can go to other places and wait for a while."
Shangguan Rouer turned around with a grateful look.
"Junior brother is such a good person."
The three-tailed white fox also rubbed its owner's calf affectionately, making a squeaking sound.
